TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD180B ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 119/2026
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED
WHOLLY WI THE TDA. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN
ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC
CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA
WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD
FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS
MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY
UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG
RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-8965/01.
